Based on the given passages, here is a brief history of Gulf Oil Company:

Gulf Oil was founded in 1901 during the discovery of oil at Spindletop, Texas. It was one of the original seven sisters oil companies and became a major global oil company from the 1900s to the 1980s. In 1985, the Canadian exploration, production, and distribution arm of Gulf Oil was sold to Olympia and York. The company continued as an independent oil company called Gulf Canada Resources until its acquisition by Conoco in 2002. Throughout its history, Gulf Oil has been known for its high-quality products and services and its iconic Orange Disk logo.
